text:
Ava: Heads up — finalizing demo-track rotations for DevCon next week. Need to lock: 2 concurrent demo pods (Serving + Benchmarks), clear inbound routing to HubSpot + webinar signups, and a concise benchmark one-pager we can hand out. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/example — please add your availability and any constraints.

Tom: Added my availability. Quick Q: how do we want to differentiate the QR flow for webinar signups vs sales leads?

Priya: Recommend 2 QR codes (webinar / sales follow-up). Both go to the same Typeform but with a hidden field for source=devcon2026 and flow=webinar|lead. Zapier then maps to HubSpot with tags. Mock form: https://form.typeform.com/to/abc123 (feel free to copy/iterate).

Liam: Can we include a quick dropdown on the form for "primary use case" (embedding/search/generation)? That helps route to the right sales lane (startup vs enterprise).

Marc: I'll design the one-pager and a 2-slide benchmark summary for the laptop. Keep the narrative simple: "Latency-first serving: 95th percentile under Xms on N GPUs; typical cost per 1k tokens vs baseline." No raw logs — just ratios and visual. Will deliver assets in 1200x630 and A4 printable.

Ava: Perfect. @Tom @Nora you own shift scheduling on-site and swag distribution. Stagger demoers every 20m to avoid overlaps. Proposed demo schedule (tentative):
```
10:00-10:40 Pod A: Serving runtime live demo (Ava/Tom)
10:20-11:00 Pod B: Benchmark walkthrough + cost breakdown (Marc/Priya)
11:00-11:20 Break / lead triage
11:20-12:00 Pod A swap: Customer Q&A + live prompt tests (Liam)
12:00-13:00 Lunch (drop in)
13:00-13:40 Pod B: Workshop — tuning batching & caching (Priya)
13:20-14:00 Pod A: Webinar CTA & signups (Ava)
14:00-15:00 Overflow / deep-dive sessions (by expertise)
```

Tom: I can cover 10:00-12:00 and 13:20-14:00. Nora can cover 11:20-13:00 and oversee swag.

Zoe: For inbound lead routing — please include utm_campaign=devcon2026 and campaign=demo-track on the QR URLs. In HubSpot, create a list for "devcon2026_demo" so we can run the post-event nurture. Also we prefer lead_score default tag "event_interest" so SDRs can prioritize.

Priya: Will add hidden UTMs and a field to capture consent checkbox + preferred contact. Zapier mapping: Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot contact create/update with tags ["devcon2026","demo-track","event_interest"] and note "scanned-qr: {flow}". I'll put the Zap steps into the sheet.

Marc: Design note — can we have a small metric strip on the one-pager: "Throughput x2 vs baseline", "Avg latency 40ms @512 tokens" (numbers are illustrative, will confirm). Also need 25 printed one-pagers and 2 A-frame signs.

Nora: Swag update — ordered: 200 stickers, 150 socks, 50 hoodies (vendor confirmed), arriving Wed before show. Vendor contact: Nora-swag@vendors.example. I can bring an extra box for printed one-pagers.

Ava: Social + benchmark narrative: want two short posts on day-of — 1) Product highlight + demo schedule CTA, 2) Thread with benchmark takeaways and link to webinar signup. Draft copy is in the doc under "Social drafts". @Marc confirm visuals fit the socials.

Marc: Confirmed. I'll export Linkedin/Twitter sizes and a short animated GIF of the benchmark chart by EOD tomorrow.

Tom: On-site checklist (quick): power strip, extra laptop dongles, local model cache (quantized), ethernet cable, battery bank, printed schedule, clipboards, sharpies, spare name tags. Anyone want to add?

Liam: Add 1 portable whiteboard and 2 markers for quick diagrams. Also bring a passive heat sink for demo laptop if running long demos :)

Zoe: Post-event follow-up ask: can we schedule a 48-hour follow-up email to all Typeform leads with 1) event highlights, 2) link to webinar recording, 3) call to action to book 1:1. I'll prepare the email template — need final one-pager and webinar link to finish.

Ava: Cool — action items recap (short):
- Priya: finalize Typeform and Zap mapping + hidden UTM (due in 24h)
- Marc: one-pager + social visuals (EOD tomorrow)
- Nora: swag pick-up and printed one-pagers (confirm vendor ETA)
- Tom: finalize shift rota and bring checklist items
- Zoe: create HubSpot campaign/list and post-event email draft
- Liam: bring whiteboard + run the use-case capture field design
- All: add availability to the spreadsheet linked above

Ava: If no blockers, we'll freeze the schedule by EOD tomorrow and print one-pagers on Wed. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Reminder set — freeze schedule in 24 hours (auto-reminder).
